item.title: momo 1.4
item.description:
momo updates itself

  • momo now checks for new versions about once a day and offers to install them. To check right away, choose momo ▸ Check for Updates…

A calmer window

  • Three ways to see your notes: sidebar, list and note; list and note; or just the note. Clicking in the sidebar no longer makes things jump.
  • Notes only show in the notes list, each with its file name at the bottom right.

Rename and move notes

  • Right-click a note in the list and choose Rename…, or double-click its name at the top of the note.
  • Drag a note onto a folder in the sidebar to move it there.
